description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cisco is hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to develop and ship end-to-end features and bug fixes for Splunk’s APM and full-stack observability platforms. The role spans Java backend microservices and React frontend applications, with on-call support and collaboration across Product, Technical, and UX teams.
Full Stack / Backend I Software Engineer building Java APM services and React interfaces, resolving backend issues and delivering observability features

Responsibilities:
• Participate in scheduled on-call rotations (~3 rotations/year) to proactively diagnose, solve, and resolve APM backend issues and customer escalations
• Develop and deploy robust, high-performance features across Java backend services and React user interfaces to provide flawless observability experiences for our customers
• Leverage AI-assisted development practices, sub-agents, and automated workflows to increase code velocity, maintain token efficiency, and tackle technical challenges faster
• Partner closely with Product Owners, Technical Owners, and UX designers to translate complex observability requirements into scalable, intuitive technical solutions
• Author clear technical documentation, participate in constructive code reviews, and contribute innovative system design ideas to continuously elevate team standards

Requirements:
• Meet one of the following (completed within the past 3 years or expected to be completed within the next 12 months):
• A Bachelor's degree with 0 years of work experience; or
• An educational or workforce development program (e.g., Associate's, Apprenticeship, Boot camp, or Certification) with 1 year of work experience; or
• High school diploma (or equivalent) with 2 years of work experience
• Qualifying education and work experience should be in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline
• Demonstrated experience developing backend services and applications using Java (or Python / Go)
• Hands-on experience building interactive web applications and user interfaces using React (or modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks)

Preferred:
• Hands-on experience demonstrating modern AI-assisted development tools, Model Context Protocols (MCPs), or developer sub-agents to streamline software workflows and automation
• Prior exposure to Splunk Observability Cloud, Application Performance Monitoring (APM), distributed tracing, cloud telemetry, or metrics platforms
• Practical experience designing data stores (SQL and NoSQL), integrating RESTful or GraphQL APIs, and deploying containerized services in Kubernetes (K8s)
• Familiarity with frontend visualization libraries (such as D3.js) and building complex, high-performance interactive dashboards
• Strong analytical problem-solving and communication skills, with a track record of effective cross-functional collaboration across Product and UX teams, paired with a drive for full-stack career growth
